title: Quireli
description: A simple mod for automation mechanisms.
body:
In the process of studying modifications for Minecraft, I have repeatedly drawn attention to those that offer innovative functionality. Among them, there are modifications that add mechanisms for automatic feeding and destruction of blocks. These tools have a complex architecture and require integration with the energy system of the game.

This modification represents the introduction of two fundamentally new blocks.:

The building block is powered by redstone with a threshold value of at least 6 units. When activated, the unit automatically places blocks from the block's inventory, which greatly simplifies the automation process and production processes.

Destruction Block — is capable of destroying all types of blocks, except non-destructible ones, without using tools. In the case of enchanted tools, the enchantment is transferred to the destructible block, which makes it possible to effectively manage the process of dismantling structures.

Good luck with automation! The mod will be finalized.
